resources.string: Swipe left, up or right anywhere on the trackpad for the left, middle or right suggestion. Swipe left no longer deletes a word.
Swipe left (picks a suggestion while Swipe direction is on)

Opens the phone\'s Scroll assistant: turn it on, the mode suggestion swipes and flicks need, since without it the phone passes no swipes to the keyboard. Also in the quick launcher as \"Trackpad scroll & cursor\".
Distance to swipe left or right to take the left or right suggestion (with Swipe directions on).
Search Settings for \"%1$s\": it\'s copied, ready to paste.
A short vibration when a swipe down deletes a word, like the one when a swipe picks a suggestion.
Android\'s swipes while Shell access is off
With Shell access chosen but not running yet (no Wi-Fi when the phone started), keyboard swipes come from Android in the apps Scroll assistant scrolls, until it\'s back.
